name: Return to Kristoff
summary: Brother Kristoff is waiting in Stormwind for a borrowed book to return. After a long search and a delay in Northshire, you bring The Stresses of Iron back to the Cathedral of Light.

sections.title: A Long-Delayed Return
sections.body: Brother Kristoff is waiting in Cathedral Square for The Stresses of Iron, a book on metallurgy. Its trail led from Stormwind Keep's Royal Library to Northshire Abbey, where Brother Paxton was copying the text by hand. Paxton ran short of Rethban ore for the scribe's ink, so the work stalled. With the ore retrieved and the copy complete, you bring the original book back to Stormwind.

sections.title: The Labor of Scribes
sections.body: Northshire's copyists preserve civic and spiritual lore through patient work. Brother Paxton asks you to apologize to Librarian Milton Sheaf, a sign of how thin the abbey's resources have worn. Scribes must copy valuable books stroke by stroke with mineral-rich ink before returning them to Stormwind's care, making a book request a long undertaking.

faq.q: What is the book The Stresses of Iron about?
aliases: what book is kristoff looking for
faq.answer: The Stresses of Iron is a treatise on metallurgy and metalworking. Brother Kristoff sought it for study in Cathedral Square, and the Northshire Abbey scribes needed a copy to preserve its knowledge.

faq.q: Why was the book at Northshire Abbey?
aliases: why was paxton holding the book
faq.answer: The Royal Library lent The Stresses of Iron to Brother Paxton so he could make an illuminated copy for Northshire Abbey's archives. His work stalled when he ran short of Rethban ore for specialized ink.

Brother Kristoff belongs to the Clergy of the Holy Light and is stationed in Cathedral Square outside the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind. He requested the book and offers spiritual blessings in gratitude.
Milton Sheaf is the head librarian in Stormwind Keep's Royal Library. He permitted the loan of The Stresses of Iron and grew impatient over the long delay in its return.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain begin?
aliases: how to start speaking of fortitude
faq.answer: The chain begins in Stormwind's Cathedral Square, where Brother Kristoff offers Speaking of Fortitude. It leads to Librarian Milton Sheaf, then Northshire Abbey and Redridge Mountains, before bringing you back to Kristoff.

faq.q: Does this quest have any follow-ups?
aliases: what comes after return to kristoff
faq.answer: Return to Kristoff ends the Speaking of Fortitude chain. When you deliver The Stresses of Iron, Brother Kristoff thanks you and offers a blessing of the Light.

angles.text: As a priest, you see how the Church of the Holy Light preserves and shares important scholarship across the kingdom.
As an Alliance member, you rely on safe roads linking Stormwind Keep, Northshire, and the embattled Redridge Mountains.
